description: This file defines the implementation of absl::flat_hash_set, a high-performance hash set container optimized for speed and memory efficiency, including class templates, member functions, and internal policies.

classes.name: absl::flat_hash_set
classes.description: A template class implementing a hash set optimized for performance, supporting various constructors, member functions for insertion, deletion, lookup, rehashing, and internal policies.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the hash set.

methods.name: cbegin
methods.description: Returns a const iterator to the beginning of the hash set.

methods.name: cend
methods.description: Returns a const iterator to the end of the hash set.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the hash set.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the number of element slots (including open, deleted, and empty) within the hash set.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the hash set is empty.

methods.name: max_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of elements the hash set can hold.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the hash set.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all elements from the hash set, invalidating references and pointers.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Erases elements by iterator, range, or key.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts elements into the hash set, with overloads for move semantics, hints, ranges, and initializer lists.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an element in-place if it does not already exist.

methods.name: emplace_hint
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an element at a hint position if it does not already exist.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts an element as a node handle, either by position or key.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges elements from another hash set into this one.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps contents with another hash set.

methods.name: rehash
methods.description: Rehashes the hash set to a specified number of slots.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves space for a specified number of elements.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the hash set.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns 1 if key exists, 0 otherwise.

methods.name: equal_range
methods.description: Returns the range of elements matching a key.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds an element by key.

methods.name: bucket_count
methods.description: Returns the number of buckets.

methods.name: load_factor
methods.description: Returns the current load factor.

methods.name: max_load_factor
methods.description: Gets or sets the maximum load factor.

methods.name: get_allocator
methods.description: Returns the allocator used.

methods.name: hash_function
methods.description: Returns the hash function used.

methods.name: key_eq
methods.description: Returns the key equality predicate.
